bio: I'm a Computer Science and Engineering student and an aspiring software engineer with a strong interest in web and software development. I work with C++, Python, JavaScript, React, Node.js, and MySQL, and I like turning ideas into practical, well-crafted solutions.

Currently, I'm a Junior Software Engineer at iobytes, where I work on real-world projects, learn industry practices, and collaborate with experienced engineers. I enjoy solving problems, exploring new technologies, and continuously improving my technical skills.

Beyond software development, I have experience with research-oriented projects, team collaboration, and technology-driven initiatives. My goal is to grow as a skilled software engineer, contribute to meaningful projects, and build innovative solutions that address real-world challenges.
